waivers.U03: Class U03 (short latency episodes smoothed by resource means). NOT machine-checked: AdvisoryAcceptanceCorpusTest has no condition for U03 (its empty condition accepts any pack), so the registry has no rule; that the pack shows high latency together with resource series whose window means stay flat is not verified by a rule, and that the episodes are short is not verified at all (the guarantee is limited to these observable aggregates). WHY the class is still guaranteed: the source is the frozen applicability trace NT06-clean (seed 2001, member 0; contract: heap, GC pause and latency are observable, short non-monotonic GC spikes need not form an episode) and the derivation dropGc removes the runtime-gc-pause series, which leaves the observable aggregates of the class: the latency check fails in both windows (p95 227 ms against the 200 ms threshold, read from the pack by the author), the resource means stay near constant (system-cpu-work mean 0.15, min 0.126667, max 0.16) and there is no GC series (the dropGc derivation removes only that series; the full series inventory is the resource_summary list of the pack itself).
